facts.text: This goal deepens the shipped prompt-catalog research baseline: expand LIVE HTTP re-checks, deepen residual high-value cards, allow selective new cards only under the strict gate, keep inventory vs live Status honesty, and regenerate/validate catalog surfaces.

Research priority is prompt engineering: official prompting/control docs, classic PE primary literature, PE contracts (templates, schemas, safety, evals as PE interfaces). Agents/tool/product multi-agent work is in scope only when it is PE-relevant (tool contracts, injection, eval flywheels as prompt interfaces), not as a separate agents-platform goal.

Do not regress the prior baseline: 48 recipes, 43 patterns, 119 sources inventory; inventory vs live Status honesty; strict new-card gate; rewrite cascade; catalog YAML SSOT with regenerated README and site-data.

Authoritative research and source freshness for this deepen pass are evaluated as of the pass date (target 2026-08-04 or actual completion day), advancing from the prior ultradeep inventory date 2026-07-31 and upgrade live set of 2026-07-25.

LIVE HTTP re-check set is expanded beyond the prior documented live sets (18 upgrade ids / 22 ultradeep ids). Only URLs actually re-fetched with successful responses get live Status marks; other rows stay inventory Status. Full live re-check of all 119 sources is not required.
source-refresh.md and sources.yaml preserve honesty: last_checked may be inventory-refresh; Status grammar distinguishes inventory vs live 200 (or equivalent). Do not bulk-fake live marks.

Multiple residual high-value PE cards are upgraded beyond the prior upgrade pass's five priority cards, using residual gaps (reasoning audit, eval depth, PE control notes, safety/injection, context as PE) as the gap-driven queue—not a forced ID list.

Edits follow the rewrite cascade: always refresh sources/evidence/API-control/safety notes; prefer recipe template and metadata upgrades; allow deeper pattern body rewrites when evidence shifted; full card rewrite only when content is wrong, misleading, or unsafe.
Catalog content is authored only in catalog/ YAML (recipes, patterns, index, schemas). README.md and web site data are regenerated, not hand-edited for recipe/pattern bodies.

Authoritative sources are provider official docs, primary papers (arXiv/ACL/OpenReview), standards (e.g. OWASP LLM Top 10, NIST AI RMF), and solid surveys. Generic blogs, SEO listicles, undated community posts, and invented citations are out of bounds.

A new recipe or pattern is added only if: no existing card covers the job; at least two independent authoritative sources support it; a clear eval or safety check is stated; and the recipe vs pattern field contract is followed. Adding a new card is optional, not a must-ship requirement.
No invented citations, benchmarks, model names, provider behavior claims, or badge signals. Provider/model claims described as current are live-verified in the same pass.

Catalog thesis is preserved: prompt patterns are testable interfaces (controls, contracts, evals, safety), not incantations or long chain-of-thought defaults. Prefer private reasoning controls, schemas, checks, citations, and tool traces.

Recipes keep the recipe card contract (Use for, paste zones, Copy prompt, Fill these in, Expected output, Upgrade when, safety/eval, Sources). Patterns keep pattern-note fields (Definition, Best use, Avoid when, template, controls, cost/latency, failure modes, evidence, sources).
Goal package includes a research ledger: residual/gap notes, source deltas (inventory vs live), and card changelog for cards touched this pass.

After catalog changes: pnpm catalog:validate, catalog:readme, catalog:site-data; python3 scripts/check_readme_recipes.py --check; python3 scripts/check_sources_manifest.py --check; and goal-scoped unit tests as needed all pass.
Hard out of scope: upgrading /agents:research skill; inventing citations or provider claims; unrelated web/UI redesign; requiring every research residual to be closed forever.
Unrelated dirty tree paths (web redesign WIP, other goals, logs) are preserved and not staged into this goal's ship set.
